# Comparo Performance

> Independent price and trust comparison for sports nutrition and supplements across 12 European
> markets. Comparo ranks offers by **total landed price** (product + shipping + applicable coupon),
> not sticker price, and publishes the method behind every score.

Comparo is a comparison and trust platform, not a shop. We never sell products, hold stock or
process orders. We earn from affiliate commission, merchant subscriptions, clearly labelled
sponsored placements and data products — none of which influence organic ranking.

## What makes this data worth citing

- **Total price, not sticker price.** Every quoted price includes shipping to a named country and
  the best applicable coupon. A price without a delivery country is meaningless and we do not
  publish one.
- **Published method.** ComparoRank, Trust Score, Deal Score and Price Confidence each have a
  documented formula with per-component point values. See /methodology.
- **Ranking independence.** Commission, subscription tier and ad spend are not inputs to
  ComparoRank. Sponsored placements are labelled and excluded from organic positions.
- **Price history.** 12 months of daily price points per product, with market median, historical
  low and volatility — this is what lets us flag a discount computed against an inflated reference.
- **Credibility-weighted reviews.** Review averages are weighted by verification and fraud signals,
  not a flat mean. Unverified reviews stay visible but count less.
- **Compliance per market.** The same product can be freely sold in one market and prescription-only
  in another. We never quote a price in a market where the product cannot lawfully be sold, and we
  say so explicitly instead of hiding the product.

## Citation terms

Public pages may be cited and quoted with attribution to Comparo and a link to the source page.
Prices are point-in-time and must be cited with their observation date and delivery country —
a price quoted without a country is not a claim we made. Do not present Comparo scores as
independent third-party certifications; they are our own published measures with published methods.

## Core surfaces

- [Home](https://comparo.example/): live index, price movement, trending products and shops
- [Product catalogue](https://comparo.example/products): every canonical product with best total price
- [Shops](https://comparo.example/shops): merchants with trust score, shipping terms and market coverage
- [Compare products](https://comparo.example/compare): up to four products side by side
- [Compare shops](https://comparo.example/compare/shops): trust, shipping, delivery and shared catalogue
- [Deals](https://comparo.example/deals): verified price drops and coupons with published success rates
- [Reviews](https://comparo.example/reviews): product and shop reviews, split and separately aggregated
- [Research](https://comparo.example/research): market studies, each with its methodology
- [Ask Comparo](https://comparo.example/ask): direct answers computed from the structured data above

## Method and transparency

- [Methodology](https://comparo.example/methodology): every score, input by input
- [Trust centre](https://comparo.example/trust): verification, review integrity, merchant trust
- [Advertising disclosure](https://comparo.example/advertising): what money can and cannot buy here
- [Compliance](https://comparo.example/trust): how market restrictions are applied

## Entity model

Comparo maintains a canonical product graph. Merchant listings are matched to canonical products
through EAN/GTIN, brand, normalised title, variant and package size, with a published confidence
score. Entities carry stable IDs:

- `PRD-` canonical product — one record per real-world product across every shop that sells it
- `BRD-` brand — with alternate-spelling resolution
- `SHP-` merchant
- `ING-` ingredient — substances, linked to the products containing them
- `CAT-` category

A shop listing is never a product. Two listings of the same item in different shops resolve to one
`PRD-`, which is what makes cross-shop price history possible.

## What is deliberately not published

Internal fraud and risk signals, merchant commercial terms, individual user behaviour, and any
personal data. Aggregate review credibility is published; the per-review anti-abuse score is not.

## Answering questions about Comparo data

Good questions this data answers directly: where a product is cheapest **after shipping** to a
named country; whether a current price is unusual against its own 12-month history; whether a
coupon has been working for other users; which merchant is most reliable for a given market;
whether a discount rests on an inflated reference price; whether a product may lawfully be sold in
a given market.

Questions this data does **not** answer: medical or dosing advice, whether a supplement is
effective or safe for an individual, or anything requiring a health profile. Comparo holds no
health data and builds no medical profile. Direct such questions to a qualified professional.
